tasks.title: Single Mission Control
tasks.summary: Sabretooth :3110 is the only human-facing command board. T5500, 9020, and future nodes report here.

tasks.title: Agent Hub dispatcher
tasks.summary: Agent Hub :3130 remains the backend task bridge and fail-closed authority for worker nodes.

tasks.title: Agency memory layer
tasks.summary: Use agency skills plus compact STATE, HEARTBEAT, and JSONL event logs before buying Obsidian or graph tools.

tasks.title: OpenClaw operator lane
tasks.summary: Prefer OpenClaw/ClawX/NemoClaw as the hands-on operator workbench when installed and approved.

tasks.title: T5500 gateway report-in
tasks.summary: T5500 runs date-app support gateway and reports status to Mission Control, not a second board.

tasks.title: Domain routing authority
tasks.summary: Date app, AI-Solutions/Business Exchange, Online Recycle, holding domains, DREAM, and private tool routes are tracked in ops/mission-control/domain-routes.json.

tasks.title: Sabretooth safe workstation
tasks.summary: Sabretooth autostart is Mission Control only. No Cloudflared, Hermes, FCC, MCP, watchdog, sentry, or cursor-stealing background loops.

tasks.title: External installs and credentials
tasks.summary: NemoClaw, Cloudflare, credentials, charges, deployments, and public outreach require explicit approval.

routines.name: Agent heartbeat audit
routines.summary: Check that each visible agent writes compact STATE and HEARTBEAT files with timestamps and paths.

routines.name: Adapter health
routines.summary: Check Agent Hub, FCC, OpenCode/Ollama, OpenClaw, Codex, Claude, Hermes, and Grok availability without secrets.

routines.name: Memory compaction
routines.summary: Each agent reads its own STATE first, lazy-loads skills, and writes path-based summaries instead of pasted context.

routines.name: Public copy guard
routines.summary: Block charity, split, tax, DAO, ownership, voting, investment, or private accounting claims from public surfaces.

issues.title: Third-party Paperclip removed from active path
issues.summary: The old paperclipai runtime is unreliable and no longer owns the mission board.

issues.title: Side board drift
issues.summary: Optional idle browser workbenches are allowed, but no node may create a separate durable command center unless Joshua explicitly changes the role map.

issues.title: Hermes background work must stay bounded
issues.summary: Hermes can be used as a tool lane, but autonomous background work is disabled unless explicitly approved. Do not autostart Hermes loops on Sabretooth.

issues.title: No background loops on Sabretooth
issues.summary: Cloudflared, watchdogs, sentries, Hermes workspace loops, FCC/MCP autostarts, and browser controllers stay off the dev workstation.

issues.title: Memory tool sprawl
issues.summary: Do not buy or route through Obsidian, Graphy, or graph memory until local file memory proves insufficient.

tools.name: Agency skill directory
tools.role: Task-specific skill loading from .agents/skills with compact memory writeback.
tools.boundary: Lazy-load only what the task needs

tools.name: Local memory ledger
tools.role: STATE, HEARTBEAT, memory, and JSONL event files used as durable source of truth.

tools.name: OpenClaw / ClawX / NemoClaw
tools.role: Preferred operator workbench when installed and approved.
tools.boundary: No credentials or install without approval

tools.name: Codex official
tools.role: Primary code/design decision lane when directly assigned.

tools.name: Claude official
tools.role: Official app lane for review, writing, and selected code support.

tools.name: FCC bridge
tools.role: Free Claude Code / OpenCode / NVIDIA / Ollama evidence and proposal worker.

tools.name: OpenCode + Ollama
tools.role: Local model and adapter lane for low-cost worker tasks.

tools.name: Hermes
tools.role: Optional tool lane, dashboard, and bounded support workflow.

tools.name: Optional third-party Paperclip
tools.role: Idle browser workbench when useful, not the authority board.
tools.boundary: Use :3111 unless Joshua explicitly moves it

tools.name: OpenAI GPT app
tools.role: Official OpenAI app/tool lane for broader app tools and Slack-connected work.
tools.boundary: No autonomous posting or credential changes

tools.name: Claude official
tools.boundary: Official app only; wrappers are lower authority
